messages.translation: The cloud drive account has changed. Please try again.

messages.source: 只有资料库所有者可以删除整个资料库
messages.translation: Only the library owner can delete the entire library.

messages.source: 发现多个同名且有内容的个人资料库，无法安全选择。请先在云盘确认要使用的资料库。
messages.translation: Several personal libraries have the same name and contain data. Review them in cloud storage before choosing which one to use.

messages.source: 已下载到：{local}
messages.translation: Downloaded to: {local}

messages.source: 已上传到云盘
messages.translation: Uploaded to the cloud drive

messages.source: 请先连接清华云盘
messages.translation: Connect Tsinghua Cloud Drive first

messages.source: 上次建库结果尚未确认，已暂停自动创建，避免重复。请刷新云盘确认，或手动创建所需资料库后重试。
messages.translation: The previous library creation is still unconfirmed. Automatic creation is paused to prevent duplicates. Refresh cloud storage to check, or create the required library manually, then retry.

messages.source: 此资料库缺少可核实的归属信息，已暂停对它自动建库、删除与同步；请先刷新资料库列表。旧版客户端请更新并重启。
messages.translation: Ownership information for this library is unavailable. Automatic creation, deletion and sync for it are paused. Refresh the library list; update and restart older clients.

messages.source: profile 页未找到 token（页面形态未知，请在云盘页手动粘贴一次）
messages.translation: Token not found on the profile page (unknown page layout; paste it manually once on the Cloud Drive page)

messages.source: 统一认证直登后仍未通过：请在设置里重新登录清华账号
messages.translation: Still not approved after direct unified authentication sign-in: sign in to your Tsinghua account again in Settings

messages.source: 云盘上还没有访问口令：请先在云盘设置页生成一次，或在 OneTHU 里用窗口方式连接
messages.translation: No access token on the cloud drive yet: generate one on the cloud drive settings page first, or connect from OneTHU via a browser window

messages.source: 统一认证直登失败：请在设置里重新登录清华账号
messages.translation: Direct unified authentication sign-in failed: sign in to your Tsinghua account again in Settings

messages.source: 统一认证会话已过期：请在设置里重新登录清华账号后再连云盘
messages.translation: The unified authentication session has expired: sign in to your Tsinghua account again in Settings, then connect the cloud drive

messages.source: 统一认证会话已过期（内存中没有清华密码）：请在设置里重新登录清华账号
messages.translation: The unified authentication session has expired (no Tsinghua password in memory): sign in to your Tsinghua account again in Settings

messages.source: 需要首次授权：云盘登录走清华 OAuth，请先在浏览器/App 里打开一次 cloud.tsinghua.edu.cn 并点「同意授权」（之后即静默）
messages.translation: First-time authorization required: cloud drive sign-in uses Tsinghua OAuth. Open cloud.tsinghua.edu.cn once in a browser or the app and click "Agree to authorize" (afterwards it stays silent)

messages.source: 统一认证确认续用失败：请稍后重试
messages.translation: Failed to confirm renewal with unified authentication. Please retry later.

messages.source: 清华统一认证要求二次认证：请在 OneTHU 里重新登录清华账号并勾选「信任此设备」，之后云盘会自动连接。
messages.translation: Tsinghua unified authentication requires two-factor authentication: sign in to your Tsinghua account again in OneTHU and check "Trust this device"; the cloud drive will then connect automatically.

messages.source: 分享密钥损坏

messages.translation: The current cloud drive account has no access to this share, or the share has been revoked

messages.translation: Share content verification failed. Ask the sender to share again.

messages.translation: The private share format is invalid

messages.translation: Assignments for the current semester are not ready yet. Select the current semester in Web Learning and retry; the existing system calendar is unchanged

messages.source: 当前平台不支持系统日历原生同步
messages.translation: Native system calendar sync is not supported on this platform

messages.source: 日程包含无效起止时间，已中止同步

messages.source: 当前平台不支持系统日历原生同步，可导出日历文件

messages.source: 校历尚未就绪，请打开日程加载学期后重试；已有系统日历保持不变
messages.translation: The academic calendar is not ready yet. Open the Schedule to load the semester and retry; the existing system calendar is unchanged

messages.source: 系统日历正在同步或移除中
messages.translation: The system calendar is being synced or removed

messages.source: 事件数 {length} 超出上限 {MAX_EVENTS}，已中止系统日历同步

messages.source: 未获得系统日历权限，请在系统设置中允许 OneTHU 访问日历
messages.translation: System calendar permission was not granted. Allow OneTHU to access calendars in system settings.

messages.source: 正在移除系统日历

messages.source: 同步已停止，已有系统日历保持不变
messages.translation: Sync stopped; the existing system calendar is unchanged

messages.source: 课表有 {skipped} 条无法解析的时段，已中止同步
